comments.author: @jean-claudelol563
comments.text: I remember back in the 90's that flights rarely got cancelled due to storms. The storms had to get really bad for mass flight cancellations. Airports were prepared for winter storms. They were prepared to regularly de-ice planes and runways. I would take off in a winter storm in Montana and land safely in another winter storm in Minneapolis and then 2 hours later take off again in the middle of a storm on a connecting flight from Minneapolis to Miami. We would encounter small delays of 30 to 40 minutes due to the need to de-ice planes but I don't recall once ever a cancelation. Unlike today when flights are delayed and cancelled regularly.
